change_intent: Add optional 'supports_oauth' capability flag to AuthenticationMethod.
rationale: Surface per-provider capability so the runtime can route to the right auth flow without provider-name string matching.

field.name: supports_oauth
field.doc: Whether this auth method supports OAuth 2.0.

semantic_contract.meaning_before: AuthenticationMethod did not record OAuth capability.
semantic_contract.meaning_after: AuthenticationMethod records OAuth capability as an optional flag.
semantic_contract.justification: Field is additive and optional; existing rows interpreted as 'unknown'.
invariants: supports_oauth=true implies the provider must accept OAuth tokens.
Setting supports_oauth does not change the visibility class of AuthenticationMethod.

tests.name: default_false_post_migration
tests.assertion: After migration, all existing rows have supports_oauth = false.

provenance.author: agent://schema-broker-1
provenance.source_prompt: we need to know which auth methods support oauth
